children.text: aho aho buddhamanantagocaraṃ audumbaraṃ puṣpamivātidurlabham // Suv_21.2 //
children.translated_text: Oh! Oh! The <s>Buddha</s>'s domain is infinite! [He is] as exceedingly rare as the <s>udumbara</s> flower!' // Suv 21.2 //
'Oh! Oh! The <s>Tathāgata</s> is compassionate! The <s>Śākya</s>-clan's banner, the sun among lords of men,

children.text: yena dṛśaṃ bhāṣita sūtramuttamaṃ sarveṣu sattvāmanugrahārtham // Suv_21.3 //
children.translated_text: by whom this supreme <s>sūtra</s> was spoken thus, for the benefit of all beings.' // Suv 21.3 //
<s>Śānteśvara</s>, <s>Śākyamuni</s> <s>Tathāgata</s>, the supreme among beings, has entered the city of peace (<s>Śāntapura</s>),

children.text: gambhīraśāstā vira ā samādhiḥ yadanupraviṣṭo inabuddhagocare // Suv_21.4 //
children.translated_text: the profound teacher, the hero, [entered] into <s>samādhi</s>, having entered the domain of the Lord <s>Buddha</s>. // <s>Suvarṇaprabhāsa</s> 21.4 //
Empty are the bodies of the <s>śrāvakas</s>, and empty are the dwelling places of the best among bipeds;

children.text: te sarvadharmāḥ prakṛtyā ca śūnyāḥ sattvāpi śūnyātma na ātu vidyate // Suv_21.5 //
children.translated_text: all those <s>dharmas</s> are empty by nature, beings too are empty — no self whatsoever is found. // <s>Suvarṇaprabhāsa</s> 21.5 //

children.text: nityaṃ ca nityaṃ ca ina smarāmi nityaṃ ca śocāmi inasya darśanam /
children.translated_text: Constantly and constantly I remember the Lord, and constantly I grieve for the sight of the Lord;

children.text: satataṃ ca nityaṃ praṇidhiṃ karomi saṃbuddha sūryasya ca darśanārtham // Suv_21.6 //
children.translated_text: perpetually and constantly I make a vow, for the sake of beholding the Perfectly Awakened One, the sun. // <s>Suvarṇaprabhāsa</s> 21.6 //

children.text: sthāpyeha nityaṃ dharaṇīṣu ānu atiśokatapto 'smi inasya darśane /
children.translated_text: Stationed here always upon the earth, I am scorched by extreme grief at the sight of the Lord;

children.text: rodimi kāruṇyavināyakatvaṃ abhisaṃtṛṣṇāsmi sugatasya darśane // Suv_21.7 //
children.translated_text: I weep for the compassionate guide, I thirst intensely for the sight of the <s>Sugata</s>. // <s>Suvarṇaprabhāsa</s> 21.7 //

children.text: śokāgninā pra valito 'smi samanta nityaṃ dadāhi me darśanatoya śītalam /
children.translated_text: I am consumed by the fire of grief on all sides constantly — grant me the cool water of your sight!

children.text: sattvāḥ satṛṣṇāstava rūpadarśane prahlādayenmāṃ karuṇodakena // Suv_21.8 //
children.translated_text: Beings are thirsting for the sight of your form; refresh me with the water of compassion! // <s>Suvarṇaprabhāsa</s> 21.8 //

children.text: kāruṇyabhāvaṃ kuru mahya nāyaka dadāhi me darśana saumyarūpaṃ /
children.translated_text: Show compassion toward me, O leader; grant me the sight of your gentle form!

children.text: tvayā hi trātā agadeva deśitaḥ śūnyāśca kāyastatha śrāvakāṇām // Suv_21.9 //
children.translated_text: For by you, the protector, the medicine has been taught, and empty are the bodies of the <s>śrāvakas</s>. // <s>Suvarṇaprabhāsa</s> 21.9 //
Equal to space, having the nature of the sky, like illusions, mirages, [reflections in] water, and the moon,

children.text: sarve ca sattvāḥ supina svabhāvā mahāntaśūnyāḥ svaya nāyakasya // Suv_21.10 //
children.translated_text: all beings have the nature of dreams, are utterly empty — [such is the teaching] of the leader himself. // <s>Suvarṇaprabhāsa</s> 21.10 //

body.text: atha bhagavānāsanādutthāya brahmasvareṇāvocat / sādhu sādhu te kuladevate śāstā dadāti sādhu te kuladevate punaśca sādhviti //
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, rising from his seat, spoke with a <s>Brahma</s>-voice: 'Well done, well done, O family deity! The Teacher grants [approval] to you. Well done, O family deity, and again, well done!'

body.text: idamavocadbhagavānāttamanāste bodhisattvā bodhisattvasamuccayākuladevatāsarasvatīmahādevīpramukhā sā ca sarvāvatī parṣatsadevamānuṣāsuragaruḍakiṃnaramahoragādipramukhā bhagavato bhāṣitamabhyanandanniti //
body.translated_text: Thus spoke the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Delighted in mind, those <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, the assembly of <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, the family deity, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Mahādevī</s> and the foremost [deities], and that entire assembly headed by <s>devas</s>, humans, <s>asuras</s>, <s>garuḍas</s>, <s>kiṃnaras</s>, <s>mahoragas</s>, and others — all rejoiced at the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s words.

body.text: iti śrīsuvarṇaprabhāsottamasūtrendrarā e nigamanaparivarto nāmaikaviṃśatitamaḥ //
body.translated_text: Thus ends the twenty-first chapter, entitled the <s>Nigamana</s> (Conclusion) Chapter, in the glorious <s>Suvarṇaprabhāsottama-sūtrendrarāja</s>.

body.text: ityāryaśrīsuvarṇaprabhāsottamasūtrendrarājaḥ parisamāptaḥ //
body.translated_text: Thus the noble glorious <s>Suvarṇaprabhāsottama-sūtrendrarāja</s> is completely concluded.
